routeSelection: refresh the catalog at connection time, use a configured route only when its protocol and availability match, otherwise use the first available route for the selected Provider; always pass the duplex protocol so the Host can auto-select when the client catalog is temporarily empty
wakeHandoff: retain bounded PCM in browser memory, wait for a finalized transcript, match the configured wake word, and pass the complete original transcript plus PCM including the wake word as the initial voiceAgent turn; unmatched audio is discarded, never persisted, and never starts Realtime
actionExecution: voiceAgent.registerActions: the voice Agent capability executes action requests, settles results through the control handoff (resolve before follow-up work), and emits action-result

curation.executor: knowledge-curator agent (personal-knowledge maintainer) via the sessionAssistantSettings/curate Remote; the tool result settles immediately, completion is announced separately
curation.boundary: the curator reads session increments plus the draft and the voice discussion and proposes durable knowledge only; confirmation stays on the knowledge-base boundary; only the discussion delta since the last successful curation is sent, and the outcome is re-injected into the voice-session context

operationalContext: always includes bounded Host-owned Session, Workspace, and primary-Agent capability metadata; the user context setting controls draft/history only, and optional personal knowledge is appended rather than carrying workspace identity
routing: local discussion and stable general knowledge stay in Session Assistant; workspace/current-state/tool/side-effect/verification work is prepared through prepare_agent_handoff and submitted only after explicit authorization
